fields.Name: T087 - Entity Form FK Search Field-Scope and Column Picker
fields.Description: Covers the advanced multi-field FK search-scope selector and column show/hide/sort controls (FKSearchableFields, OnFKScopeToggle, OnFKHeaderSort) — a distinct advanced code path layered on top of basic FK search.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Event Registrations' entity via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box, open a record's full form, and click Edit. Click a foreign-key field to focus it — a small scope 'pill' (magnifying-glass + field name + chevron) may appear next to the input when the related entity has more than one searchable field. Click that pill to open a menu listing which field is being searched and column show/hide (eye) toggles. Success is seeing EITHER the scope/column picker menu render when the pill is clicked, OR (if the related entity has only one searchable field) the FK results dropdown with sortable column headers. You do NOT need to change or save anything. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Focusing an FK field shows the search UI with either a scope pill (multi-field) or a results dropdown with column headers
Clicking the scope pill opens a field-scope/column-visibility menu, OR the results dropdown clearly renders sortable column headers
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
